content:
Field
Description
UserUUID
The username of the person who created the scheduled report/search entity in the UI. (Typically an email address)
UserID
The system-generated UUID of the person who created the scheduled report/search entity in the UI.
ExecutionID
The unique system-generated ID of the scheduled report/search execution.
ReportID
The UUID of the scheduled report/search entity that the execution generated from.
ReportName
The user-defined name of the scheduled report/search entity.
ReportType
A string value representing the report type:
cloud_security_posture_detections_ioa: Scheduled reports with indicators of attack (IOA) findings
cloud_security_posture_detections_iom: Scheduled reports with indicators of misconfiguration (IOM) findings
dashboard: Scheduled reports from dashboards
discover_applications: Scheduled reports with asset management - application data
filevantage: Scheduled reports with FileVantage monitored file change data
hosts: Scheduled reports with host management data
spotlight_installed_patches: Scheduled vulnerability management reports with installed patches data
spotlight_remediations: Scheduled vulnerability management reports with remediation data
spotlight_vulnerabilities: Scheduled vulnerability management reports with vulnerability data
spotlight_vulnerabilty_logic: Scheduled vulnerability management reports with vulnerability evaluation logic data
event_search: Scheduled searches

Field
Description
ReportFileReference
A partial URL that would allow for the report to be downloaded via the /reports/entities/report-executions-
downloads/v1 endpoint.
Status
An integer representing the state of the execution with 1 representing “Done” (successful execution), 2 representing “Failed”, and
3 representing “No Data”.
StatusMessage
A human-readable description of the status with an empty string representing a successful execution.
